HomeProto.heroSub: Eastern silhouettes cut with Western restraint, in matte natural cloth — refined by proportion, drape and finishing. Nothing added to be seen; everything made to be felt.
HomeProto.heroSlotCap: Full-bleed welcome image — uploaded & swapped from the admin portal per edition
HomeProto.statement: The market signals value through what it *adds*. We signal it through what remains — *proportion, drape, and finishing*. Eastern in silhouette, Western in restraint: two traditions meeting in a single clean line.
HomeProto.editEyebrow: The current edit · refreshed each edition
HomeProto.editEmpty: No published pieces in this door yet.
HomeProto.fabricTitle: Fabric is the first thing that reads as luxury.
HomeProto.fabricLead: Every cloth a natural fibre — matte or low-sheen, chosen for how it drapes and how it ages. Texture and weave replace ornament.
HomeProto.fabricCrepeCh: Matte, fluid yet weighted; holds a clean line.
HomeProto.fabricSilkCh: Structure with a restrained, low sheen.
HomeProto.fabricOrganzaCh: Crisp, sheer, holds its own shape.
HomeProto.atelierTitle: Cut by hand, in natural cloth.
HomeProto.atelierP1: Construction is the product: hidden pockets, covered fabric buttons, deep curved hems, panels cut into the cloth and never gathered on. Cut by hand, finished with care, made to outlast the season.
HomeProto.atelierP2: The fusion lives in the line, never a logo.
HomeProto.atelierAks: aks — a reflection. A dress that reflects you, in both worlds.
signatures: Cut by hand from natural cloth
Panels and flare cut into the cloth — never gathered on
Deep, softly curved hems, so the garment carries weight and hangs true
Covered fabric fastenings, matched to the cloth — never metal
Invisible finishing, inside and out — the seam is part of the design
Standard house sizes, cut to a considered fit
